macros.name: currfile
macros.doc: Two temporary sudoku files, \prevfile and \currfile, are used during the generation.

macros.name: elimcross
macros.doc: Eliminate all solutions in column 5 and row 5.

macros.name: elimcrossandex
macros.doc: Eliminate all solutions in column 5 and row 5 and on the diagonals.

macros.name: elimcrossandexandnines
macros.doc: Eliminate all solutions in column 5 and row 5 and on the diagonals, and all 9’s.

macros.name: elimcrossandnines
macros.doc: Eliminate all 9’s and the solutions in column 5 and row 5.

macros.name: elimex
macros.doc: Eliminate all solutions on the diagonals of the grid.

macros.name: elimnum
macros.doc: \elimnum{⟨num⟩} eliminates every solution ⟨num⟩ (e.g. \elimnum{7} will eliminate every 7 from the grid).

macros.name: elimseventeen
macros.doc: \elimseventeen randomly eliminates the solutions for 17 cells in the grid (apparently if two numbers are completely eliminated as clues in a puzzle, then at best the solution is ambiguous).

macros.name: genfile
macros.doc: The generated puzzle, and its solution, is typeset and the puzzle is also output in the sudoku file \genfile.

macros.name: initialelimination
macros.doc: The macro \initialelimination eliminates an initial set of solutions from the randomized starting grid.
